title: Bodyweight squat

steps.text: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips and your toes turned slightly out.
steps.cue: Feet a little wider than hips.

steps.text: Reach your arms forward. Bend your knees and sit your hips back, as if toward a chair.
steps.cue: Arms forward. Sit your hips back.

steps.text: Go only as low as is comfortable. Keep your heels down and your chest lifted.
steps.cue: As low as is comfortable. Heels down.

steps.text: Press through your feet and stand up tall.
steps.cue: Press through your feet and stand.

mistakes: Lifting the heels off the floor.
regression: Bend your knees only a little, with one hand on a wall.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your knees, hips or lower back.

anatomy.why: The front of the thigh and the buttocks straighten the knees and hips to stand you up.
